Recorded 2026-11-06 at about 14:10 Europe/Berlin with Nextflow 26.04.6, its pbspro executor and nf-gadi 1.4.0, with fake qsub, qstat and qdel: two tasks, BIG (2 CPUs, 1 GB, 1 hour) and SMALL, in the queue normal. The fake qsub appended a resource summary with the labels that nf-gadi reads to each job log, with values from the job number n: SUs 0.0n, 2n CPUs, CPU time 00:00:0n, walltime 00:00:0(n+1), memory 1n.5MB of n.0GB, JobFS 0B of 100.0MB.
report.csv: the CSV report of the first run; report-resume.csv: the report of the resumed run, both tasks cached; report.json: the JSON report of a run with format json.
